note: Gate Joomla/K2 file downloads (/index.php/<category>/item/download/<id>_<hash>) behind the clearance-cookie challenge. A visitor who solved the challenge once downloads freely; an uncleared one-shot scraper gets the challenge instead of the multi-MB file. Starts disabled - set your vhost(s) (or ["*"] for the whole server, admin only) and run the simulator with a real /item/download/ URL, then enable. Swap action.type to "block" (priority 306) for zero tolerance, accepting that an uncleared human hitting a download link cold gets a 403.
